blocks.text: Your first full day at leisure on San Andrés. Enjoy the beaches, the clear waters of the Sea of Seven Colours and the resort facilities. No excursions are scheduled today: you choose how to spend your day. Optional excursions and activities can be arranged at an additional cost. All-inclusive accommodation at the island resort. Overnight on San Andrés.

blocks.text: Another full day at leisure on San Andrés, with no scheduled activities. Enjoy a morning by the sea, swim and watch the changing colours of the Caribbean throughout the day. You can use the resort facilities or explore the island on your own. Optional excursions and activities can be arranged on request at an additional cost. All-inclusive accommodation and your third night on San Andrés.
